patterns.note: Full-width sections with content consistently centered, often featuring large, impactful headings that span the width of the content area.
Dominant use of an extremely bold, wide sans-serif typeface for the main brand logo and key section headlines, creating a strong, declarative visual voice.

A high-contrast color palette featuring deep charcoal/black backgrounds paired with vibrant, almost neon, accent colors (orange, green, teal, purple, yellow) used for geometric shapes and occasional text highlights.

A persistent, animated background layer featuring floating, colorful octagonal shapes that subtly parallax and move independently as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and playfulness across the entire page.
Content sections are introduced with large, declarative headings, often followed by a grid of feature cards or illustrative graphics that visually explain the core concepts.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video plays on loop in the hero section, serving as a dynamic and immersive background for the primary branding and call to action.
The primary navigation bar transitions from an initial transparent state to a sticky, solid-background state as the user scrolls past the hero section, ensuring continuous access to key links.

Colorful octagonal shapes are animated using CSS keyframes or GSAP, floating and parallaxing across the background of various sections, including the hero and footer, providing a consistent visual motif and sense of depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extremely bold headings (~4-5x body text) with a modern, clean sans-serif for body copy and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and cards feature slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, leaning towards airy in the hero and between major sections, with a comfortable density in feature grids.

standout: The distinctive use of the oversized, bold 'Tesoro' logo as a recurring visual element, combined with the vibrant, floating geometric shapes against a dark, immersive background, creates a unique brand identity that feels both modern and playfully sophisticated. The persistent animated background elements are particularly memorable.
